suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update Decision (c) traceability to note ConsoleStreamPump stays independent (source-driven model doesn't fit Bounded's request-response pattern). Current text says 'All three runtimes delegate to Bounded' which is inaccurate.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: cmp-runtime-bounded reviewer found the architecture doc claims all 3 runtimes delegate but only 2 do. The README correctly explains this.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a convention that widget utility functions (truncate, center, runeWidth, padOrTruncateWidth) should be extracted to a shared utils.go file rather than living in entity_list.go. Multiple widgets now depend on these.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: cmp-detail-pane, cmp-tabs, and cmp-unicode-width reviewers all noted that utility functions in entity_list.go are reused by other widgets without clear ownership.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify the inactive tab color token — spec says 'plain' but implementation uses TextMuted. Either update the spec to name TextMuted or update the implementation.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: cmp-tabs reviewer found the mismatch between spec and implementation for inactive tab coloring.
